biology.plant-responses-data-plot.0004.a: time on x, angle on y, labelled with units, linear scale, points correct, smooth curve
biology.plant-responses-data-plot.0004.b: angle increases quickly at first, then rate slows and levels off at about 38 degrees by day 4-5

biology.plant-responses-data-read.0004.b: (angle at 4 - angle at 1)/3 degrees per day
biology.plant-responses-data-read.0004.c: auxin moves to shaded side; stimulates cell elongation there; shaded side grows faster so bends to light (positive phototropism)

biology.plant-responses-describe.0001.all: auxin made in shoot tip; moves to shaded side; causes cell elongation on shaded side; shaded side grows faster so shoot bends towards light

biology.plant-responses-describe-multi.0.b: shoot grows upwards (negative geotropism), root grows downwards (positive geotropism); auxin collects on lower side; inhibits root cell elongation / stimulates shoot cell elongation

biology.plant-responses-explain.0003.all: rotation means gravity/light acts equally on all sides; auxin distributed evenly so equal elongation on all sides

biology.plant-responses-explain-multi.00.b: shoot grows towards light so leaves absorb more light; more photosynthesis, more glucose for growth

biology.plant-responses-mcq-rev.0005.all: A change in the environment that is detected

biology.plant-responses-prac-method.0001.all: same number/species of seedlings in each box; same soil, water, temperature; leave several days; measure direction/angle of bending and height; compare

biology.plant-responses-prac-plan.0002.all: plan: germinating bean seeds pinned to damp cotton wool; one on rotating clinostat, one stationary; same species/age, temperature, dark to exclude light; leave 2-3 days; observe/measure root curvature; repeat with several seeds

biology.plant-responses-prac-reliab.0001.a: identify anomalies, calculate mean, more reliable since biological variation
biology.plant-responses-prac-reliab.0001.b: the all-round light box (or dark box) as control; shows bending is due to directional light, not other factors

biology.plant-responses-prac-risk.0001.a: sharp pins - handle carefully / mould - wash hands; or electrical clinostat near water - keep dry
biology.plant-responses-prac-risk.0001.b: measure angle with a protractor / mark starting position of root tip

biology.plant-responses-prac-step.0004.all: seeds need water to germinate/grow; prevents drying out so roots keep growing

biology.plant-responses-prac-vars.0001.c: type of seedling; temperature; water; time

biology.respiration-data-graph.0001.a: temperature increases with time (steadily); quote values
biology.respiration-data-graph.0001.b: peas respire aerobically; respiration releases energy as heat; vacuum flask insulates so heat not lost

biology.respiration-data-pct.0003.b: higher temperature, more kinetic energy, enzymes work faster up to optimum; faster respiration; more oxygen used (CO2 absorbed by soda lime) so drop moves further

biology.respiration-data-plot.0001.a: axes labelled with units, scale, points, line
biology.respiration-data-plot.0001.b: temperature increases steadily from 18 to 27 C over 5 days

biology.respiration-data-read.0002.c: respiration releases heat energy; flask insulates

biology.respiration-describe.0004.all: ATP provides/stores energy for cell processes; made in respiration, broken down to release energy e.g. for muscle contraction, active transport

biology.respiration-describe-multi.0007.b: yeast produces ethanol and carbon dioxide; muscle produces lactic acid and no CO2

biology.respiration-explain.0007.all: woodlice respire; release carbon dioxide; CO2 increases acidity, so indicator turns yellow

biology.respiration-explain-multi.0001.b: kills microorganisms on seed surface; their respiration would also release heat and affect results
